'''Levet''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who owned a [[Levet's farm|small farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Located near the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], it was situated just down a dirt road from the [[Beviin-Vasur farm]].<ref name="Revelation" />
